# Example Co

> Example Co makes free website tools that check titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.

The tools run in the browser and do not require an account. Results are informational and do not guarantee rankings.

## Tools

- [Site Checker](https://www.example.com/site-checker.md): Audits one URL for common technical SEO issues
- [Schema Generator](https://www.example.com/schema-generator.md): Builds JSON-LD for common schema.org types
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://www.example.com/robots-txt-generator.md): Builds and tests robots.txt rules

## Guides

- [How to write a robots.txt file](https://www.example.com/guides/robots-txt.md): Syntax, testing, and AI crawler rules
- [XML sitemap basics](https://www.example.com/guides/sitemaps.md): Format, limits, and submission

## Optional

- [About Example Co](https://www.example.com/about.md): Company background
- [Changelog](https://www.example.com/changelog.md): Recent updates to the tools
